findings.title: updateManyByCredentialId called with empty data throws
findings.body: CalendarService.ts line 1024 calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) with an empty data object. Prisma rejects updateMany with empty data with a validation error ("data must not be empty"), so every execution of fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache will throw after writing the cache instead of touching SelectedCalendar.updatedAt. This breaks the cache-warming path that runs after watching calendars. Pass an explicit touch like { updatedAt: new Date() } or remove the call.

findings.title: Delete-cache success never refreshes cache status
findings.body: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx defines deleteCacheMutation with onSuccess that only shows a toast and calls onSuccess?.(), but unlike disconnectMutation it never invalidates trpc.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. The cacheUpdatedAt prop comes from that query, so after deleting the cache the dropdown will keep showing the old "Last updated" timestamp until a manual refetch. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query on success/settled.

findings.title: Cache status includes expired rows
findings.body: CalendarCacheRepository.getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups by credentialId with no expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability only honors rows with expiresAt >= now. A credential whose rows are all expired will still return a max(updatedAt) and the UI will show "Cache Status / Last updated" and offer deletion for a cache that is effectively unusable. Filter the groupBy to non-expired rows (expiresAt gte now) or otherwise distinguish no-valid-cache.

findings.title: Generic Error instead of typed TRPC error for auth failure
findings.body: deleteCache.handler.ts throws new Error("Credential not found or access denied") when the credential is not owned by the caller. Thrown as a generic Error this surfaces as an internal server error instead of NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN, loses the intended authorization semantics, and is inconsistent with tRPC error handling. Throw a TRPCError with code NOT_FOUND or FORBIDDEN.

findings.title: Cache timestamp hardcoded to en-US locale
findings.body: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx formats cacheUpdatedAt with new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...), ignoring the user's locale from useLocale. Users in other locales will see a US-only date format inconsistent with the rest of the app. Use the active locale for formatting.

findings.title: macOS-only sed breaks script on Linux
findings.body: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh updates GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL with sed -i '' -E, which is macOS/BSD syntax. On Linux/GNU sed the empty '' is treated as a filename and the script fails to update ../.env. The script also uses a relative ENV_FILE ("../.env") that depends on cwd. Make the in-place edit portable (detect OS or use a temp file) and resolve the env path relative to the script.

findings.title: dev:cron switched to tsx without dependency
findings.body: apps/web/package.json changes dev:cron to "npx tsx cron-tester.ts" but tsx is not added to dependencies or devDependencies (only ts-node is). On clean installs, offline CI, or pinned environments npx may fail or fetch an unpinned version, while neighboring scripts still use ts-node. Add tsx as a devDependency or keep ts-node.
